title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
summaryZh: 人心是情感、行動與信仰的中心，在神眼中這才是最重要的。
lines: Now tonight I want you to turn with me to the 22nd chapter of Matthew's gospel.
今天晚上，我想請你們和我一起翻到《馬太福音》第二十二章。
And I want to speak on the subject, "A Cure for Heart Trouble."
我想講的主題是「心病的解藥」。
Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him and saying, "Master, which is the great commandment in the law?"
「內中有一個人是律法師，要試探耶穌，就問祂說：『夫子，律法上的誡命，哪一條是最大的呢？』」
And Jesus said unto him, "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul and with all thy mind."
「耶穌對他說：『你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主你的神。』」
"This is the first and the great commandment, and the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself."
「這是誡命中第一，且是最大的。其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。」
"On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets."
「這兩條誡命是律法和先知一切道理的總綱。」
All the law and all the prophets hang on these two commandments.
所有的律法和先知一切的道理，都繫於這兩條誡命上。
I want to give you the scripture text again so you can memorize it.
我想再給你們一次經文，讓你們可以背下來。
是《馬太福音》二十二章37、38、39和40節。
And it's no mistake that Jesus made.
"Love the Lord thy God with all thy heart and all thy soul and all thy strength."
「要盡心、盡性、盡力愛主你的神。」
You know, here in Syracuse, as you enter the city on I-690 there's a huge billboard announcing that Syracuse is the heart of New York State, and I believe it is.
你們知道，在雪城這裡，當你們從 I-690 公路進入這座城市時，有一塊巨大的廣告牌宣稱雪城是紐約州的心臟，我相信確實如此。
It's the heart of New York State, and President Roosevelt, Franklin Roosevelt and elder Roosevelt were associated worldwide with central New York.
它是紐約州的心臟，而羅斯福總統——富蘭克林·羅斯福和老羅斯福，在全世界都與紐約州中部聯繫在一起。

And Bernard Baruch, who was one of the great philosophers and advisor to six presidents and one of the most brilliant Jewish leaders in the country and a friend to me, once was asked by Eleanor Roosevelt who said,
而伯納德·巴魯克，他是一位偉大的哲學家、六位總統的顧問、美國最傑出的猶太領袖之一，也是我的朋友，有一次艾蓮娜·羅斯福問他：
"If my head says one thing and my heart another, which should I follow?"
「如果我的理智說一回事，而我的心說另一回事，我該聽從哪一個？」
And Bernard Baruch said to Mrs. Roosevelt, "Follow your heart."
伯納德·巴魯克對羅斯福夫人說：「聽從妳的心。」
You see, your heart is the center of your life.
你看，你的心是你生命的中心。
You know, if you think about your heart, your physical heart, it beats a hundred thousand strokes every twenty-four hours.
你知道，如果你想想你的心臟，你肉體的心臟，它每二十四小時跳動十萬次。
It contracts four thousand times an hour.
Our blood weighs about twenty-five pounds and all of it passes through the heart every four minutes.
我們的血液重約二十五磅，所有的血液每四分鐘就會流經心臟一次。
In Proverbs 23:7 the Scripture says, "As a man thinketh in his heart, so is he."
在《箴言》二十三章7節，經文說：「因為他心怎樣思量，他為人就是怎樣。」
And the heart is used throughout the Bible, considered far more than a bodily organ.
而在整本聖經中都有提到「心」，它被認為遠不止是一個身體器官。
It's the seat of our emotions.
As boys, I remember we used to write our initials on trees, or on the side of some barn our girlfriend's name and a picture of the heart.
我記得小時候，我們常在樹上刻下自己名字的首字母，或者在穀倉旁邊寫下女朋友的名字，並畫一顆心。
Valentine's Day is a day for sweethearts and the symbol is a heart.
情人節是情侶的節日，而其象徵就是一顆心。
When we become frightened or excited, we put our hands over our hearts.
當我們感到害怕或興奮時，我們會把手放在心上。
It's the center of our emotions.
When we salute the flag, like we did the other day at the Rotary Club, when they were saluting the flag and singing the Star-Spangled Banner, we put our hands over our hearts.
當我們向國旗致敬時，就像我們前幾天在扶輪社那樣，當他們向國旗致敬並唱《星條旗》時，我們把手放在心上。
Or saying some of the great patriotic things, we put our hands over our hearts.
或者在說一些偉大的愛國宣言時，我們把手放在心上。
The heart is also the seat of decisive action.
心也是決定性行動的中心。
The Bible says, "The fool hath said," not in his mind, but "in his heart, there is no God."
聖經說：「愚頑人說，」不是在他腦海裡，而是「在他心裡說，沒有神。」
And the scripture says in Proverbs 4, "Keep thy heart with all diligence, for out of it are the issues of life."
而經文在《箴言》四章說：「你要保守你心，勝過保守一切，因為一生的果效是由心發出。」
The heart is the seat of belief as well as the basis of doubt.
心是信仰的中心，也是懷疑的基礎。
Christ said, "For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts and murders and adulteries and fornications and thefts and false witnesses and blasphemies."
基督說：「因為從心裡發出來的，有惡念、凶殺、姦淫、苟合、偷盜、妄證、謗讟。」
But you have something wrong with your heart, and I have something wrong with my heart.
但是你的心出了問題，我的心也出了問題。
Our hearts are diseased by a disease the Bible calls sin.
我們的心患了一種聖經稱之為「罪」的疾病。
You see, the heart is also the seat of life.
你看，心也是生命的中心。
The Bible says your heart will live forever.
聖經說，你的心將永遠活著。
Think of it, your body is going to die and go to the grave, but your heart, your soul, your spirit, will live forever.
想一想，你的身體會死亡並進入墳墓，但你的心、你的靈魂、你的靈，將永遠活著。
A thousand years from tonight it will still be alive.
從今晚起一千年後，它依然活著。
When God looks at man, He doesn't look at the color of his skin, the kind of clothes he wears, or his social position.
當神看人時，祂不看人的膚色、穿著打扮，或社會地位。
The Bible says out of the heart of a black person or an oriental person or a white man or woman, out of the heart are the issues of life.
聖經說，無論是黑人、東方人、白人男性或女性的心，一生的果效都是由心發出。
And no physician on earth can tell one from the other.
世界上沒有任何醫生能分辨它們的差別。
We're all alike in the sight of God.
在神眼中我們都是一樣的。
The Bible says, "Man looks on the outward appearance, but God looks upon the heart."
聖經說：「人是看外貌，耶和華是看內心。」
And in the scriptures, the heart is considered the symbol of the entire person.
在聖經中，心被視為整個人的象徵。
When Steven of Colona fell into the hands of his assailants and they asked him in derision, "Wherein now is your fortress?"
當科隆納的斯蒂芬落入襲擊者手中，他們嘲笑著問他：「現在你的堡壘在哪裡？」
Steven placed his hand over his heart and said, "Here is my fortress."
斯蒂芬把手放在心上，說：「這裡就是我的堡壘。」
Helen Keller, who was blind and deaf and dumb, wrote, "The best and most wonderful things in the world cannot be seen or touched but are just felt in the heart."
集盲、聾、啞於一身的海倫·凱勒寫道：「世界上最美好、最奇妙的事物是看不見也摸不著的，只能用心去感受。」
You see, the heart has come to stand for the moral, spiritual and intellectual life of a person.
你看，心已經成為一個人道德、屬靈和理智生活的代表。
It's the seat of a person's conscience and life and extremely important.
它是一個人良知和生命的中心，極其重要。
And the question I want to ask you tonight is this: "Is your heart right?"
而今晚我想問你們的問題是：「你的心對了嗎？」
Is your heart right, is it right with God?
你的心對了嗎？它在神面前是對的嗎？
Because if it's not right with God, your sins are not forgiven.
因為如果它在神面前不對，你的罪就沒有得到赦免。
You're not going to heaven when you die.
Our hearts have to be right.
I do not ask about your outward life.
I don't ask about your intellectual life or your financial status or your social life.
我不問你的理智生活、財務狀況，或社交生活。
